Question 9
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration a(t)=4e4t, where t≥0 is the time. If the particle has position x=12 and velocity v=1 when t=0, calculate the position x of the particle at time t>0.

a
x(t)=e4t+t+14
b
x(t)=3e4t−14
c
x(t)=e4t2
d
 x(t)=e4t+2t2
e
x(t)=e4t+14
Submit
